description.zh:
集群的可维护时间，格式为`HH:mmZ- HH:mmZ`。例如`16:00Z-17:00Z`，表示0点到1点（UTC+08:00）可进行例行维护。 

> 可维护时间为整点，时长为1小时。
description.en:
The maintenance window of the cluster. The format is `HH:mmZ- HH:mmZ`. For example, `16:00Z-17:00Z` indicates that routine maintenance can be performed from 00:00 to 01:00 (UTC+08:00).

> The maintenance window must start on the hour and last for one hour.

title.zh: 修改实例集群可维护时间段

descriptions.zh: > 建议您将集群可例行维护的时间设置在业务的低峰时间段。阿里云会在您设置的可维护时间段内进行集群维护，保证对业务的影响降到最低。
descriptions.en: > Set the routine maintenance window for the cluster to a time during off-peak hours. Alibaba Cloud performs cluster maintenance during this window to minimize the impact on your business.
